about: Which text entries hold the gear's names: the weapon names (EquipParamWeapon) and the armour names (EquipParamProtector), each keyed by its row id. Counts only; no name and no row id.
decision: EldenNet's game data, gap 3; DESIGN §4.5; WHY§105
rule: A text entry's layer is the earliest that holds it: 0 the base game (11 and 12), 1 the expansion's first layer (321 and 322), 2 its second (421 and 422), in any of the item containers. A row is named when its row id is an entry of the set.
